mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.nickname, r.code AS role, u.status, u.onboarding_completed AS onboardingCompleted, u.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id AND r.is_active = 1 WHERE u.id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.admin_login_name AS adminLoginName, r.code AS role, u.status, u.auth_version AS authVersion, u.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id AND r.is_active = 1 WHERE u.id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.admin_login_name AS adminLoginName, r.code AS role, u.status, u.auth_version AS authVersion, u.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id AND r.is_active = 1 WHERE u.email = #{email} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = 1, auth_version = auth_version + 1 WHERE id = #{userId} AND auth_version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
